name: DingDing
source:
Robot/Mini Android

DingDing is Angel's personal robot assistant and a defacto "pet" as well friend; she's customizable in appearance.
She relays messages for Angel and helps Angel with her work.

[From [url=http://altabestudio.com/works/ea-pinocchio/]official site[/url]]
